doc: Linear search over a byte table: base address D_80085FA4[0], element count/bound D_800869B0[0]. Starting at byte index `a0`, scans forward comparing 4 bytes at (base + index) against the fixed 4-byte pattern D_800330FC via func_80058800 (a strncmp-like helper). Returns (index + 4) on the first match, or -1 once the index exceeds D_800869B0[0].
